Class Packet

java.lang.Object

    • Packet

      public Packet(int CMD, String[] args)
      Creates a packet with a command and argument. Intended to be used with the host when interpreting a message.
      Parameters:
      CMD - command identifier
      args - packet arguments

    • Packet

      public Packet(String[] args)

      Parameters:
      args - packet arguments

    • Packet

      public Packet(String arg)
      Creates a response-style packet from one argument. Used to tell the client the message body to reply to the user with.
      Parameters:
      arg - message body

    • Packet

      public Packet(int userID, String arg)
      Creates a packet containing a user identifier and message. Used in the host to decode which user is sending a message.
      Parameters:
      userID - identifier of the user
      arg - message body
